summary: Assert populated owner-filtered event-page membership and scanned-cursor continuation in an invented fixture.

replay.detail: Only a test fixture changes; existing stores and event replay are unchanged.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, claim definitions, or schema version change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, digest, sealing, or authorization rule changes.

compatibility.detail: No client, peer, wire, or CLI runtime contract changes.

downtime.detail: No daemon or deployment path changes.

manual.detail: No installation action is required; the new fixture runs with the ordinary test suite.

recovery.detail: Reverting the test removes the fixture without changing stored data or runtime behavior.
